subject: Request: Staggered commitment + prefunded credits — exec approval needed
messages:
From: Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@heliocare-sys.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial ask + SOW (HelioCare pilot)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move the pilot forward. Procurement asked me to surface one ask before legal drafts the final SOW: HelioCare is requesting a prefunded credit of $50k and a first-year effective discount of 27% off list for the initial 12-month pilot, with a committed 3-year renewal if metrics hit the agreed thresholds.

High level:
- Pilot: 12 months, prefunded credits $50k to be applied against usage
- Commit: 3-year minimum following pilot; expected 3-year spend ~$1.15M
- Requested commercial concession: effective 27% discount in year 1, tapering thereafter

Procurement says this needs a VP/CFO sign-off because the initial concession exceeds their standard approval thresholds. Can you route this internally and let me know the expected timeline for an exec decision? We need a signed SOW to start procurement approvals. I attached the draft SOW and a short procurement checklist.

Best,
Claire
Claire Reynolds
Sr. Procurement Manager — HelioCare Systems
Attachments: HelioCare_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), HelioCare_Procurement_Checklist.docx
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Commercial ask + SOW (HelioCare pilot) — recommendation for staggered concession

Marissa / Ben — forwarding HelioCare's ask (see attached SOW). Quick summary: they want $50k prefunded credit + ~27% effective discount yr1 with a 3-year commit. They explicitly asked for VP/CFO sign-off.

My recommendation (to preserve unit economics while landing the logo):
- Offer structure: 20% off list for year 1 on usage (applied after credits), 10% off list for years 2–3 conditional on meeting agreed usage ramp (70% of committed monthly baseline).
- Prefunded credits: accept $40k credits (applied first), not $50k. Credits are non-refundable and must be consumed within 12 months.
- Upfront consideration: require 6 months prepayment of committed baseline to reduce risk.
- Limit premium support to standard onboarding (no white-glove unless add-on purchased).

Why this is justified: HelioCare is in a vertical (remote monitoring) that will give us high visibility and vertical reference. Expected FY1 ARR contribution (net of credits) ~ $360k, 3-year expected revenue $1.05M. If they hit the ramp the account should expand.

Risks to call out:
- If they under-consume, credits reduce short-term revenue recognition and compress margin.
- Security evidence requests may add costs — ask for SOC 2 attestation timeline in SOW.

I think anything >20% first-year requires VP-level clearance; anything >25% should go to CFO. Asking for your guidance and quick signoff so I can respond to procurement within 48 hours. Attaching proposed commercial grid and a short margin impact calc.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: heliocare-proposed-commercial-grid.xlsx, margin-impact-memo-q2.pdf
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Commercial ask + SOW (HelioCare pilot) — recommendation for staggered concession

Dylan — thanks for the clear recommendation and the supporting numbers. I ran a quick margin back-of-envelope with Finance (cc Laura). A few follow-ups before I can approve to send externally:

1) Reduce the first-year discount to 18% (not 20) if we agree to $40k credits + 6 months prepay. That preserves ~6pt of gross margin relative to your ask.
2) Add a clawback: if they fail to hit 70% of committed monthly baseline in any two consecutive quarters, remaining credits are void and any unused credits convert to a 30-day repayment term.
3) Require SOC 2 Type II within 9 months of SOW execution or a signed milestone schedule in the SOW.
4) Approve supporting the prefunded credit at $40k, conditional on a shortened onboarding credits window (must be used within 9 months).

If Dylan agrees, I can approve at VP level today. Anything beyond the above (e.g., higher credits, longer usage forgiveness) will need CFO signoff. Laura: did you want to add any AR / payment language here?

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

---
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Commercial ask + SOW (HelioCare pilot) — notes from Finance

Quick finance notes: we can support $40k prefunded credits but require either (a) 6-month prepayment of baseline or (b) full-year prepayment of at least 50% of the estimated FY1 spend. Also recommend a revenue recognition clause that defers credit consumption against revenue until usage is delivered.

If Marissa signs off at VP level on the 18%/40k/9mo terms, Finance will accept and we can route for signature. Anything more generous goes to CFO.
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@heliocare-sys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial ask + SOW (HelioCare pilot)

Claire — thanks for your patience while we reviewed internally. Good news: we can move forward with a modified commercial that secures the pilot and preserves the path to a 3-year commit. High-level approved terms (VP-level):

- Prefunded credits: $40,000 (applied first; non-refundable). Must be consumed within 9 months of SOW start.
- Year 1 discount: 18% off list (applied after credits).
- Years 2–3: 10% off list, conditional on meeting the agreed usage ramp (>=70% of monthly baseline).
- Payment: 6 months of baseline prepayment required at SOW execution. Alternatively, HelioCare may choose 50% FY1 prepayment instead.
- Clawback: if they miss the ramp (two consecutive quarters below 70%), remaining credits void and any remaining balance becomes payable within 30 days.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II or an agreed milestone schedule within 9 months is required in the SOW.

Marissa (VP, Revenue Ops) and Finance have approved the above. If acceptable, I’ll circulate a redlined SOW to procurement and legal today and request signatures.

Next steps on our side: I’ll attach the updated commercial grid and a redline of the SOW. Can you confirm whether HelioCare prefers the 6-month prepay or the 50% FY1 prepay option? Once you confirm, I’ll push the SOW to legal.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: heliocare-proposed-commercial-grid.xlsx (updated), HelioCare_SOW_v1_redline.pdf
